 About the Role:
 We are looking for an OT DevOps Engineer to support the operation, automation, and continuous delivery of industrial Operational Technology platforms .
The role focuses on applying DevOps practices within Industrial Engineering and OT environments , particularly across OT Platforms, Energy Management Systems (EMS), SCADA, PLC and DCS ecosystems . You will contribute to the reliability, availability, security, and continuous improvement of OT platforms by combining CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, monitoring, and cybersecurity practices .
Your Responsibilities:
Operate, monitor, and maintain OT platforms, proactively responding to alerts and ensuring high availability, reliability, and platform performance;
Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines for OT and industrial environments;
Automate testing, deployments, configuration, and operational processes to increase reliability and minimize platform downtime;
Work with Microsoft Azure CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) processes supporting OT platform delivery and operations;
Collaborate closely with DevOps, IT/OT, engineering, cybersecurity, and business teams to integrate DevOps practices into industrial workflows;
Apply OT cybersecurity requirements and security best practices, supporting secure and compliant platform operations and software delivery;
Troubleshoot platform and deployment issues, drive continuous improvement, and contribute to the adoption of new automation, monitoring, and DevOps technologies;
 Your Profile:
Hands-on DevOps experience within Industrial Engineering or Operational Technology projects, preferably involving OT Platforms, EMS, SCADA, PLC or DCS environments.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar technologies, ideally applied within OT/industrial environments.
Experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps/CI/CD, automation frameworks, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) processes.
Good understanding of OT architectures, industrial systems and protocols, particularly environments involving SCADA, PLCs and DCS.
Experience with Linux environments, preferably Red Hat or equivalent, combined with solid troubleshooting and platform operations skills.
Understanding of OT cybersecurity requirements, security best practices, and industry standards, with a security-by-design mindset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, proactive approach to monitoring and operations, and the ability to collaborate effectively across IT, OT, engineering, and business teams.

Whether you're diving into Generative AI, data science, or sustainability, our digital campus supports your learning journey every step of the way;
Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from an attractive package including medical services, eye glasses coverage, Benefit online, meal tickets, Employee Assistance Program (covering financial, legal, and emotional matters), and the Employee Share Option Plan.
